verdict.rationale: Mistral documents function calling as connecting models to user-defined functions and external tools [mistral-docs-4][mistral-docs-34], and its Agents API supports tool use, state persistence and multi-agent handoffs, which implies multi-step agent loops [mistral-docs-2][mistral-docs-21][mistral-docs-20]. However, the evidence never shows the typed tool-definition schema or parallel tool calls, and nothing independently confirms reliable tool-call behaviour. Missing for 10: explicit typed/JSON-schema tool definition docs, parallel tool-call support, documented multi-step tool loop in the function-calling API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-calling reliability.
